Descrição da empresa

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com colaboradores no mundo, contamos com escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui  aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos

e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar

a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à  identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. O profissional precisa desenvolver todo o ecossistema de um dos programas estratégicos ICONIC, desde a estratégia de marketing até o plano de expansão geográfica. A missão do cargo é ser um motor no desenvolvimento do programa, consolidando e avançando em conjunto com as áreas técnicas, marketing, suprimentos, operações, tecnologia e comercial.

  • Liderar o processo de prospecção, estruturação e escalonamento de novos operadores locais e regiões para o programa, em colaboração com as áreas de suprimentos, logística e engenharia.
  • Garantir a governança do programa, assegurando a gestão dos resultados volumétricos, financeiros e da eficiência logística.
  • Realizar gestão indireta do time multifuncional envolvido no programa.
  • Administrar o CAPEX e OPEX relacionados ao programa.
  • Promover atualizações contínuas do conceito do programa por meio de benchmarking.

  • Graduação em Engenharias, Economia ou Administração de empresas.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We're helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst  to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You'll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role where flawless work is non-negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers, detail-obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets.

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time) 
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote 
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1440-$2200 (based on a 24-hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3-statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation-ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis-ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model-Led)
    Produce deal-ready schedules for buy-side and sell-side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double-check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless.
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A, ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique.

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn-outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self-check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • They own the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • They balance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • They translate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Finance Case + bonus assignment

  3. Second Interview

Valuation Case Test
Final Interview

O objetivo é promover a excelência operacional, cumprindo os padrões e níveis de serviço (SLAs), ao mesmo tempo que se incentiva uma cultura de melhoria contínua e transformação. Esta posição exige pensamento estratégico e fortes competências de liderança, sendo imprescindível a capacidade de gerir uma equipa diversificada e colaborar com líderes de RH e de negócio para alinhar os serviços de RH com os objetivos organizacionais. O Gerente Serviços de RH Senior desempenhará um papel crucial na melhoria da experiência dos colaboradores, na otimização dos processos de RH e na garantia do cumprimento das leis e regulamentos laborais em toda a região.

Descrição do cargo


O Gerente de Serviços de RH Senior será responsável por:

  • Liderança e Gestão: Liderar e gerir a equipa de Serviços Compartilhados de RH, assegurando a prestação de um serviço de qualidade e um excelente atendimento ao cliente.
  • Operações de RH: Supervisionar as operações de RH, incluindo Administração de Salários e Benefícios, Serviços ao Colaborador, Gestão de Dados, Relatórios e Aquisição de Talentos.
  • Melhoria de Processos: Implementar políticas e procedimentos de RH para aumentar a eficiência e a eficácia. Promover a padronização, consolidação, automação e melhorias dos processos.
  • Conformidade: Garantir o cumprimento das leis e regulamentos trabalhistas em todos os países apoiados.
  • Colaboração: Colaborar com as áreas de RH e líderes de negócio para compreender as suas necessidades e alinhar os serviços de RH em conformidade.
  • Monitorização de Desempenho: Monitorar os indicadores de RH e utilizar dados para impulsionar melhorias contínuas. Assegurar o cumprimento dos padrões e SLAs.
  • Transformação: Liderar a identificação, desenvolvimento e execução de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, apoiando os objetivos estratégicos globais da organização de Serviços Partilhados.
  • Experiência do Colaborador: Melhorar a experiência global dos colaboradores com os serviços de RH, focando o apoio em soluções de autosserviço com padrões adequados.
  • Outsourcing Estratégico: Manter e melhorar o suporte da equipe de Global Business Services para atividades administrativas e transacionais.
  • Integração Tecnológica e Automação: Colaborar com HRIS para implementar tecnologias de RH, manter e melhorar os sistemas existentes.

Você é ideal para esta oportunidade se:

  • Graduação em área relacionada a Recursos Humanos, ou MBA/Mestrado em área técnica com experiência profissional relacionada com RH.
  • Sólida experiência em posição de liderança, gerenciando equipes diretamente
  • Proficiência no inglês
  • Conhecimento, competências e experiência em operações de RH, Serviços Compartilhados de RH, implementação de projetos e sistemas e/ou gestão de mudança em organizações complexas. Experiência consolidada com sistemas e fornecedores de processamento salarial, ServiceNow e sistemas HRIS como Oracle e SuccessFactors.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multiculturais e geograficamente dispersas.
  • Experiência em revisão e mapeamento de processos.
  • Experiência na implementação de Serviços Compartilhados de RH e modelos de prestação de serviços em diferentes níveis.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido (4 vezes por semana no escritório) e para viajar para outros locais e países.

Habilidades Adicionais

  • Excelentes competências estratégicas e operacionais
  • Ótimas competências de colaboração e capacidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e sistemática
  • Forte senso de equipe, capacidade de delegar tarefas e de potencializar o desempenho dos membros do time
  • Capacidade de pensar de forma inovadora ("fora da caixa") para influenciar conceitos ou resolver problemas
  • Demonstrar habilidade para comunicar e envolver stakeholders em todos os níveis de forma concisa, organizada e profissional
  • Capacidade para envolver, motivar e desenvolver equipes e colaboradores
  • Capacidade para trabalhar com gestão remota
  • Histórico comprovado de impulsionar mudanças e influenciar a organização em todos os níveis, colaborando e trabalhando transversalmente para atingir objetivos

title: Associate - Immigration services
description:
Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to 'Connect the world'. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Description
As an Associate, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and immigration experience, helping our clients solve their complex immigration issues from strategy to execution. Innovation forms a critical part of the role and you will be asked to continually reassess how we deliver immigration services to ensure the best experience for our clients and colleagues.

Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:

  • Proactively manage a portfolio of clients, providing support and guidance throughout the immigration process
  • Assist in administrative tasks and contribute to the successful delivery of large-scale projects
  • Stay updated on local and national business, economic, and immigration-related developments
  • Conduct in-person appointments at various locations, such as the Federal Police and Consulates, alongside immigrants
  • Collaborate with Managers and above to ensure effective client management and project execution

Qualifications

  • Minimum Degree Required: Bachelor's degree in a related field
  • Required Fields of Study: Immigration Law, International Relations, Business Administration, or related fields
  • Minimum Years of Experience: 1-3 years of experience in immigration services or related field
  • Certification(s) Required: Any relevant certifications in immigration law or related areas would be advantageous, but not mandatory

  • Supporting improvements in parametric design and template development in CREO;
  • Participating in supplier visits when required;

  • Technical degree in Mechanics (Mechanical Technician or equivalent);

Detail-oriented, collaborative, and organized professionals who enjoy working in a global and multidisciplinary environment. Individuals who value accuracy, continuous improvement, and the rigorous documentation required in offshore structural design.

A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros, focada no(a) cliente e na transformação da indústria de pagamentos para apoiar o empreendedorismo brasileiro. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades

Nossa Cultura:


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento

No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros

Team Play: Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida


Gerente Comercial de Crédito Stone:


Sua missão vai muito além da simples oferta de crédito. Você será o principal parceiro estratégico dos empreendedores mais influentes da sua região, realizando um diagnóstico financeiro profundo de cada negócio. Com base nessa análise, você desenhará e implementará estratégias de crédito personalizadas, integrando-as a um ecossistema completo de soluções Stone em finanças, software e gestão. Seu objetivo é garantir não apenas a melhor solução de crédito, mas uma experiência de excelência que impulsione de forma decisiva o sucesso e a competitividade dos nossos clientes.


Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Rotina híbrida com reuniões presenciais e online;     
  • Estabelecer contato com clientes para oferecer soluções de crédito adequadas;     
  • Conduzir negociações e construir relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes;     
  • Gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes, assegurando a satisfação e a retenção;     
  • Realizar visitas comerciais para prospecção de novos clientes e manutenção de relacionamentos;     
  • Analisar a capacidade de pagamento dos clientes com rigor, assegurando decisões de crédito informadas e seguras 

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólido conhecimento em produtos de crédito e do setor financeiro;     
  • Experiência em riscos de crédito na concessão de crédito e matemática financeira;     
  • Habilidade em negociação e gestão de carteira;     
  • Conhecimento do mercado regional e experiência em vendas;     
  • Capacidade de interpretar e aplicar políticas de crédito de forma clara.

Somos referência em experiência de atendimento, qualidade técnica e ambiente acolhedor, entregando beleza, cuidado e prosperidade para clientes e equipe.

  • Sinalizar à Gerente de Salão qualquer necessidade observada no ambiente (limpeza, cliente desconfortável, espera excessiva etc.).

  • Ensino fundamental completo (desejável ensino médio completo).

  • Simpatia, gentileza e excelente apresentação pessoal.
  • Atenção a detalhes e capacidade de observar sem ser invasivo.
  • Proatividade e disposição para servir e ajudar, mesmo em atividades simples.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, respeitando hierarquia e rotinas.
  • Equilíbrio emocional para lidar com dias de maior movimento sem perder a cordialidade.

title: Engineer II, Senior Technology- Marine/ Mechanical/ Environmental
description:
Description

Are you passionate about being at the forefront of emerging technologies in the maritime and offshore industries?  
 

ABS is a leading Classification Society driven by its mission to promote the security of life and property and preserve the natural environment. In fulfilling this mission, ABS leads research and develops guidance and requirements focused on the safety of implementing new technology in the marine and offshore environment. 
 

As a Marine/ Mechanical / Environmental Engineer, you will be actively engaged in driving industry-leading research and development associated with machinery and systems for marine and offshore applications. 
 

What You Will Do:

  • Lead research and assess the maturity of new technologies in the marine industry related to carbon capture, CO2 transportation, non-carbon/ low carbon-based fuels, renewable energies including different machinery and systems etc.). 
  • Establish guidance and classification requirements for the marine and offshore industry on the application of new technology. 
  • Support ABS technical community on queries regarding different onboard mechanical equipment and systems.
  • Maintain and demonstrate thought leadership through technical publications and presentations. 
  • Participate in industry societies to develop and enhance technical capabilities. 
  • Remains knowledgeable of new scientific methods and developments affecting the technical scope of assigned responsibilities and recommends changes in engineering processes and programs as warranted by such developments. 
  • Devises new approaches to problems encountered and recommends changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary. 
  • Monitors the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects. 
  • Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists, internally and externally. 
  • Assist Principal Engineer and/or immediate superior in developing qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials. 
  • Promotes ABS Quality System within an assigned group of engineers.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years relevant engineering experience in the energy industry, shipyard, design/consulting company, shipping/oil company, university, or classification society.
  • Minimum of a bachelor's degree in mechanical/ marine/ environmental engineering or other related discipline; M.S. is preferred.
  • Having experience or knowledge with AI as it relates to mechanical/maritime concepts is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of onboard machinery and systems is a plus, including emerging technologies such as carbon capture (both pre- and post-combustion), CO2 transportation, ammonia crackers, methane reformers, methane slip, renewable energies, electrolyzers, and energy-saving devices.  Also, basic understanding of marine piping systems (e.g., fresh water, sea water, lubrication oil, fuel oil, compressed air, hydraulic system, cryogenics piping, etc. 
  • Knowledge of general mechanical systems. 
  • General knowledge of environmental engineering. 
  • Awareness of alternative marine fuels, such as hydrogen, ammonia, methanol, synthetic fuel, and biofue,l etc.
  • Awareness of fuel cell technology and application. 
  • Awareness of emerging technologies and trends in the marine industry, including emerging engines, fuels, power generation, and energy savings. 
  • Strong communicator with excellent oral and written communication skills. 
  • Excellent command of the English language. 
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others. 
  • Ability to learn the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

This position reports to a Senior or Manager level position or above.

COMO É SER UMA PESSOA MOTORISTA EM MSF?

Você será responsável por realizar o transporte seguro de passageiros autorizados e mercadorias da MSF, garantindo o bom estado do veículo, o cumprimento das leis de trânsito e o respeito às normas de segurança da organização.

Sua atuação é essencial para o bom funcionamento das atividades do projeto e para a segurança das equipes em campo.

QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

Conduzir veículos da MSF em contextos urbanos, lidando com tráfego intenso e situações adversas;

Garantir a segurança de passageiros, cargas e do próprio veículo;

Cumprir rigorosamente as normas de trânsito e os protocolos de segurança da MSF;

Atuar com atenção, responsabilidade e comunicação clara com a equipe de logística.

COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Realizar o transporte diário de passageiros e mercadorias autorizadas;

Verificar diariamente as condições técnicas do veículo (combustível, pneus, óleo, freios, limpeza e documentação);

Preencher corretamente o diário de bordo e demais registros do veículo;

Garantir o correto carregamento e descarregamento de materiais;

Comunicar incidentes, avarias ou ocorrências ao supervisor de logística;

Utilizar corretamente rádios e sistemas de comunicação da MSF;

SEGURANÇA, RESPONSABILIDADE E CONFORMIDADE

Respeitar rigorosamente as regras de segurança da MSF, especialmente em deslocamentos, postos de controle e bloqueios;

Garantir que passageiros conheçam e respeitem as normas de segurança;

Manter sempre válidos e disponíveis os documentos do veículo e a CNH.

Experiência mínima de 2 anos como motorista;

Bons conhecimentos das vias, bairros e estradas do Rio de Janeiro;

Experiência com direção defensiva e tráfego intenso.

O QUE É UM DIFERENCIAL?

Experiência com veículos 4x4

Experiência prévia em MSF ou em outras ONGs.

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
Quality Engineer, Product QA

Description

The Quality Engineer, Product QA will report solid line to the Regional Quality Manager and will be responsible for ensuring effective application of the Baker Hughes Quality Management System (QMS) and customer requirements for the relevant scope of work handled internally (in-house) or externally (suppliers). The successful candidate will be responsible for auditing technical requirements, and implementing controls for its adherence, and exercising problem solving, quality reporting and improvement in a daily basis, and as a result ensuring a role model in regards to continuous improvement for components fabrication, top assembly unitization and product validation processes.

The Quality Engineer, Product QA will be responsible for:

  • Ensure product quality performance is reviewed and improved in a frequent matter at execution sites.

  • Collaborate with Lean initiatives towards processes improvements to ensure the flawless execution.

  • Lead first article process in suppliers and in-house, making sure the product process is well established aligned with product requirements, through of using risk assessment tools such as but not limited to FMEA.

  • Run product quality audits and walks in a frequent basis to certify product requirements are properly met.

  • Act as a risk assessor for product manufacturing and any risks of execution are properly identified and mitigated.

  • Support and/or lead Go No Go process for fabrication start and facilitate pre-production meeting.

  • Ensure operations Lessons Learned are properly captured, solved and communicated to Supply Chain and Product Delivery Team.

  • Act as a quality agent for culture development promoting workshops for continuous improvement.

  • FMEA

  • Ensure product non-conformances are properly identified, technically reviewed to promote strategic actions for continuous improvement.

  • Implement and control product Key Performance Indicators.

  • Handle communication with direct colleagues and the business about approach and methods for solving complex problems

  • Adhere to Product Line directive for standard quality requirements in fabrication sites

  • Witness product inspections and processes/product qualification inspections.

  • Ensure critical observations are registered and concerns are properly identified and escalated to the respective levels of the organization.

  • Lead manufacturing review processes for all new first article involving the relevant stakeholders.

  • Be an agent for implementing Non-Conformance Management process at extended sites.

Required Characteristics

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in (Mechanical or Production Engineering).

  • Fluent English skills.

  • Knowledge in local Brazilian customer quality requirements related to fabrication of subsea equipment including XT, Manifolds and Tooling.

  • Previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.

  • Experience in Quality and product requirement audits.

  • Knowledge in product quality inspection and documentation analysis.

  • Experience in quality tools for developing improvement actions (A3, 8D, 5whys, fishbone, FMEA, 5S, Lean Six-Sigma).

RequiredSkills

  • Strong leadership skills.

  • Negotiation and influencing skills with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Clear thinker and effective communication.

  • Problem solving skills.

  • Interpretation of technical documentation from design drawing, specification and quality requirements.

  • Ability to coordinate several activities simultaneously. Effective problem identification and solution skills. Proven analytical and organizational ability.

  • Exercise collaboration and ethic on everything that is done.

Desired Characteristics

  • Master Degree in Quality discipline.

  • Technical product qualification by external parties as (Dimensional, Painting, Welding or NDT, Fabrication).

Location:Curitiba, PR

title: Data Annotator
description:
Objectives


Chemin, TDCX's AI-focused subsidiary, is opening up a new gigwork opportunity for individuals who want to earn more while contributing to cutting-edge AI projects.

We partner with leading global companies to power next-generation AI solutions. For this project, we are teaming up with a major player in the gaming industry, and we're inviting motivated, English-fluent individuals to join us as Data Annotators.

This role is fully remote, task-based, and gives you the flexibility to increase your income at your own pace while playing a direct role in shaping smarter, human-verified technology.

As a Data Annotator, you will listen to short audio clips and complete three core tasks:

  • Segment: Divide the audio based on different speakers
  • Tag: Identify the language and accent of the speaker(s)
  • Transcribe: Convert spoken English into written text

Your work will directly improve the accuracy of AI models, helping build smarter, real-world solutions. You will receive training and ongoing support from Project Managers to set you up for success.

If you're passionate about technology, eager to make a meaningful impact and contribute to enabling AI solutions, this is the opportunity for you

Deliverables

  • Deliver high-quality transcriptions of audio clips with minimal revisions
  • Segment spoken content into distinct, meaningful components
  • Identify and label speakers and their accents accurately
  • Communicate effectively with Project Managers on challenges, questions, or feedback
  • Meet key deadlines while maintaining quality and consistency

Qualifications

  • Moderate English fluency (B2 level or higher) to handle diverse accents

  • Excellent listening skills and good comprehension of written texts.

  • A laptop or desktop computer with a stable internet connection

  • Precision, consistency, and attention to detail
  • A growth mindset with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to project requirements
  • Efficient time management to deliver consistent output

Bonus points if you have:

  • Fluency in Portuguese (Brazilian Accents)
  • Prior experience in transcription or data annotation projects
  • Academic background in any STEM, Social Sciences, Psychology, Linguistics, Humanities, or similar fields

Working Arrangements

  • This is a fully remote, gig-based project with flexibility in when you work
  • To ensure project goals are met, we are looking for annotators who can commit working days (around 4-6 hours daily) during the project period
  • The more time you dedicate, the faster you learn, the more tasks you can complete, and the higher your earnings will be. Consistency is key to success
  • The project runs from December 2025 to January 2026
  • No cap on earnings. The more you complete, the more you earn

Benefits

  • Add a flexible side hustle to your existing commitments
  • Earn up to 3 USD per accepted task
  • Gain hands-on experience in the fast-growing AI industry
  • Be part of Chemin, TDCX's fast-growing AI subsidiary, and work on projects that shape the future

Furthermore, support discipline lead to monitor, maintain and conduct the periodic revalidation of the MAH Register, Bowtie and SCE lists for the operating fleet.

Contamos com a tua energia

Estágio Profissional | Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Brasil)

Junta-te à Galp e traz a tua curiosidade e paixão no dia a dia

Irás integrar a unidade de negócio de Energy Management que inclui atividades como o abastecimento, compra e venda (trading) e expedição de petróleo, biocombustíveis, gás natural, eletricidade e produtos ambientais - quer a partir de capital próprio da Galp, quer a partir de terceiros.

Sabe mais sobre a tua futura equipa

Suporte a equipe de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Originação Estruturada) do Energy Management, participando de atividades relacionadas ao mapeamento e estuturação de oportunidades, gestão e acompanhamento de projetos, além de participar do stakeholder management interno da área.

title: Environmental Education Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The Environmental Education Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

São Paulo, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is developing a project with the Municipality of São Paulo through the Secretariat of Green and Environment (Secretaria Municipal do Verde e Meio Ambiente - SVMA) that includes the revision of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan and the elaboration of the Municipal Sanitation Plan. To properly implement this project, an Environmental Education Consultant is required to work directly on the phases 3 (Study of Solutions) and 4 (Action and Goals Plan), to ensure adequate planning considering the current situation and future forecast for the city of São Paulo. These stages involve defining and proposing possible solutions to the problems and bottlenecks identified in the diagnostic phase, as well as developing the Action and Goals Plan, both consolidated in Product 3.8.1, the "Final Study of Solutions, Action and Goals Plan" of the Integrated Solid Waste Management Plan. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Environmental Education Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Environmental Education Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities. Based on the diagnosis prepared regarding solid waste management in the municipality of São Paulo, the consultant will develop the following topics, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze the municipal solid waste management diagnosis, identifying key issues, challenges, threats, and bottlenecks that hinder progress in management and the implementation of sustainable solutions; b) Identify and define priority axes for the development of educational, socio-environmental, and sustainability-oriented solutions; c) Prepare preliminary proposals for programs, projects, educational approaches, communication strategies, and pedagogical materials aligned with the defined priority axes; d) Establish technical criteria and reference parameters to guide the formulation of contracts, investment plans, service targets, and educational initiatives related to solid waste management; e) Contribute to the analysis of cost structures and financing models for educational actions linked to urban cleaning and solid waste management services, in coordination with the Public Finance Consultant; f) Assess and describe educational solutions, detailing their application across the territory and within the municipal governance structure, considering different target audiences (residents, schools, large generators, communities, cooperatives, etc.); g) Interact directly with the consultants from stages 3 and 4 to ensure the effective application of the solutions identified for the formulation of actions and goals aimed at improving environmental education in the management of urban solid waste; h) Develop additional activities related to environmental education and solid waste management that may be identified by the project coordinator. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Environmental Education Consultant shall assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Work Plan. Description: The Work Plan must contain (at a minimum): (i) Detailed scope of the deliverable products, focusing on the stages, methodologies, and related activities required to conduct the study on environmental education for solid waste management; (ii) Details of the information, documents, and data required to support the technical analysis and development of solutions; (iii) Schedule of activities and delivery dates for each phase of the consultancy; (iv) Description of the flow of review, technical validation, and approval of the products; (v) Identification of key municipal institutions, programs, and actors relevant to the environmental education agenda in solid waste management and the strategy for institutional articulation during the consultancy. Expected delivery date: 15 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Integrated Study and Action Plan for Environmental Education in Solid Waste Management. Description: The Integrated Study and Action Plan for Environmental Education in Solid Waste Management must contain: Part 1: Study of Solution (i) Analysis of the complete diagnosis of municipal solid waste management, with emphasis on the environmental education component; (ii) Identification of key issues, structural bottlenecks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement within the current system; (iii) Critical review of institutional arrangements, existing programs, and communication practices related to waste management education; (iv) Identification and definition of priority axes for the development of sustainable and effective educational strategies within the solid waste sector; (v) Consideration of behavioral, social, environmental, territorial, and operational factors that influence educational outreach and citizen engagement; (vi) Assessment of national and international good practices, pedagogical models, and educational frameworks related to waste management and analysis of the relevance, adaptability, and applicability of these practices to the context of São Paulo; (vii) Preparation of preliminary proposals based on the defined priority axes; (viii) Development of programs, projects, pedagogical approaches, training models, thematic campaigns, communication materials, and tools tailored to different target audiences (e.g., residents, schools, cooperatives, large generators, communities); (ix) Determination of initial technical criteria, requirements, and institutional conditions necessary for the implementation of the proposed solutions; (x) Identification of intersectoral interfaces with municipal policies and institutions (e.g., PGIRS, PMEA 2024–2034, UMAPAZ Work Plan, SELIMP, SP Regula, SMSUB); (xi) Consolidation and detailing of the proposed solutions and definition of how they should be operationalized within the municipality of São Paulo; (xii) Specification of responsible institutions, required resources, key implementation steps, and enabling conditions. Part 2: Integrated Action and Goals Plan (i) Formulation of a structured Action and Goals Plan derived from the proposed solutions; (ii) Definition of objectives, expected outcomes, and clear implementation pathways for each action; (iii) Establishment of quantitative and qualitative goals, performance indicators, and monitoring mechanisms aligned with the strategic guidelines from PGIRS and complementary municipal policies; (iv) Estimation of preliminary costs and feasibility considerations for prioritized actions; (v) Identification of potential funding sources, partnership opportunities, and collaborative arrangements to support implementation; (vi) Ensuring coherence between the proposed actions, goals, and the PGIRS Action and Goals Phase; (vii) Integration of the educational strategies into São Paulo's broader municipal waste management planning framework. Expected delivery date: 60 days after signing the contract. The products must be delivered in accordance with the formatting and drafting guidelines adopted by UN-Habitat.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Pedagogy, Engineering, Biology or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Waste Management, Environmental Education, Environmental Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years or relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• Minimum of six (6) years of experience in Environmental Education applied to waste management is required.
• Experience in Public Management is required.
• Professional experience developing studies, projects, plans and technical assessments related to environmental education and waste management is required.
• Experience in project management is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Excellent writing and proof-reading skills in Portuguese are required.

description:
Descrição da Empresa
Navocean é especializada em consultoria ambiental, licenciamento e monitoramento para atividades sísmicas e de perfuração. Estamos comprometidos em promover práticas sustentáveis e em atender rigorosos padrões ambientais.

Descrição do Cargo

title: Atuário de Reservas
description:
Venha construir essa jornada conosco

Somos movidos pelo propósito de ampliar a sensação de segurança das pessoas com quem nos relacionamos, simplificando interações e criando, lado a lado, as melhores soluções.

Tudo isso com a essência da
Australidade
, que traduz nosso jeito único de fazer acontecer: proximidade, transparência, colaboração e foco em resultados. É assim que transformamos desafios em oportunidades e entregamos valor para todos os nossos parceiros.

Atribuições:

  • Analisar os resultados e oscilações das reservas e ativos garantidores com olhar crítico para prevenção de possíveis erros e desvios irreais de passivo;
  • Atuar ativamente na elaboração, atualização e análise das premissas do TAP e CMR;
  • Suporte e revisão crítica do cálculo mensal da prévia dos ativos garantidores necessários para dar suporte à diretoria financeira;
  • Auxiliar nos questionamentos técnicos realizados pela auditoria atuarial, contábil e interna;
  • Buscar constantemente a otimização dos dados e relatórios que dão suporte às atividades da área, a melhoria de processos realizados e a revisão dos cálculos estabelecidos, a fim de ter maior clareza e precisão nas informações geradas para a tomada de decisão da alta administração;
  • Auxiliar na preparação de dados para atendimento à solicitações do Conselho de Administração, Órgãos Reguladores, agências de rating, Auditores Externos e Internos e demais instâncias da administração da Companhia;
  • Atentar-se as premissas de cálculo utilizadas pelo departamento e buscar um contínuo aperfeiçoamento das mesmas;
  • Atentar-se e aos impactos gerais dos valores gerados pela área e estar apto a antecipar seus efeitos a nível contábil, regulatório e de resultado.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Atuariais;
  • Conhecimentos atuariais em reservas técnicas, CMR, Ativo Garantidor e TAP;
  • Domínio de Excel;
  • Conhecimento em programação (python e SAS serão considerados diferenciais).

Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Atenção e responsabilidade no desenvolvimento das tarefas;
  • Bom raciocínio lógico;
  • Ser criativo na resolução de problemas;

Profissional que demonstre interesse em buscar novas atividades e que tenha facilidade para produzir novas ideias.

title: Assistente Social
description:
Horário de trabalho
09h as 15h - segunda a sexta-feira

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em Serviço Social;
  • CNH categoria B e veículo próprio;
  • CRESS ativo;
  • Experiência com mediação;
  • Experiência na área da saúde.

Sobre a vaga

  • Aplicar Pesquisa de Satisfação aos familiares ou cuidadores;
  • Orientar as famílias sobre o funcionamento do atendimento domiciliar;
  • Intermediar a comunicação do paciente e familiar entre a Lar e Saúde e as operadoras de saúde;
  • Realizar contato telefônico, visita domiciliar e/ou reunião solicitada pela Equipe Multidisciplinar de Atenção Domiciliar;
  • Elaborar Relatório Social dos casos de atendimento domiciliar com questões sociais evidenciadas.

Tipo de vaga: Efetivo CLT

Benefícios:

  • Assistência odontológica
  • Estacionamento gratuito
  • Vale-alimentação
  • Vale-refeição

Pergunta(s) de seleção:

  • Você possui CNH categoria B?
